links.outcome: CPT code accuracy of six LLMs on cardiac ICU procedures, ECMO vs non-ECMO
links.effect: Non-ECMO accuracy ranged from 56% (GPT-4.0) to 88% (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Perplexity). ECMO accuracy ranged from 0% (GPT-4.0) to 86% (Perplexity), with Claude 3.7 Sonnet at 14%.
links.quote: For ECMO-related codes, Perplexity outperformed all models (86%), followed by Gemini 2.5 Pro (71%), Mistral (43%), DeepSeek (29%), Claude 3.7 Sonnet (14%), and GPT 4.0 (0%).

screen.reason: Evaluates six off-the-shelf LLMs on their accuracy in assigning CPT billing codes for cardiac critical care procedures without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
